install_symbols.why: zECS's install jobs (JCL/CONFIG.jcl, DEFEXPR.jcl) replace @ecs_hlq@ and @environment@ in ZCEXPIRE.idcams and the CSD's DEFINE FILE(ZCEXPIRE) DSNAME; this case installs one environment, high-level qualifier ZECS and environment TEST

vsam.why: Source/ZCEXPIRE.idcams: INDEXED KEYS(4 0) RECORDSIZE(80 2048), RECORDFORMAT(V) in the CSD. Every record the program writes and reads is its ZX-RECORD, 70 bytes (LENGTH OF ZX-RECORD), whose first 4 bytes are the key

scenarios.name: interval-not-elapsed
scenarios.why: the control record ZX01 on file was written 600 s before the task (its interval is 1800 s): 1400-UPDATE finds RELATIVE-TIME below the TTL, so 8000-RESTART (START TRANSID(EIBTRNID) INTERVAL(1500) with the 20-byte ZC-PARM) and 9000-RETURN end the task before the expiration browse of the instance's file

scenarios.name: control-record-duprec

faults.why: the control record is not on file: 1300-WRITE
another expiration task wrote it first

scenarios.why: READ UPDATE of the control record NOTFND, so 1300-WRITE writes it, and the WRITE answers DUPREC (a task of the same instance wrote it first): 8000-RESTART and 9000-RETURN end the task before the browse

scenarios.name: enq-busy

faults.why: another expiration task of the instance holds the ENQ (NOSUSPEND: the task is not suspended, ENQBUSY is raised)

scenarios.why: 1200-ENQ ENQ RESOURCE(ZC-EXPIRE-ENQ) NOSUSPEND answers ENQBUSY (IBM raises it for an unavailable resource with NOSUSPEND; register X60): 8000-RESTART and 9000-RETURN end the task before the control record is read

notes: zECS's expiration task for one instance (ZECS000, started by the ZX## transaction, here ZX01: EIBTRNID names the instance's files ZC01FILE and ZC01KEY, and the control file ZCEXPIRE). #5089: the CICS file ZCEXPIRE is defined with install symbols (CSD DEFINE FILE DSNAME @ecs_hlq@.ZCEXPIRE.@environment@) and zECS's IDCAMS job is Source/ZCEXPIRE.idcams, which the engine does not read as a define. The case states the substitution ("install_symbols": ECS_HLQ ZECS, ENVIRONMENT TEST -- never guessed) and the file's KEYS(4 0) from that job ("vsam" under the resolved name). RECORDSIZE(80 2048) and RECORDFORMAT(V) make ZCEXPIRE a variable-length KSDS; the stub keeps fixed-length records, so the case states reclen 70 -- every record the program writes and reads is its ZX-RECORD (LENGTH OF ZX-RECORD) -- and "variable": true says so; a record of another length would be a different case. The control record in zcexpire.bin is the one written 600 s before the task. The task is started with no start data (RETRIEVE answers ENDDATA: ZC-KEY stays LOW-VALUES) at the harness's STARTCODE 'S'. HOLES, named: ZC##FILE and ZC##KEY are named at run time from the RETRIEVEd transaction id (#4771) and defined by zECS's own IDCAMS jobs with install placeholders, so the Java side refuses the READ of the instance's file by name (Hole 'CICS file FILE: no store in the generated project') where GnuCOBOL answers FILENOTFOUND; every path that goes on to the expiration browse (2000-READ-FILE and everything after: the DOCUMENT / WEB replication, 3100-3220 deletes, 8100-RESTART) is therefore not in the case, and its paragraphs are uncovered and unproven (coverage 9/38 paragraphs). The two scenarios end before it: the control record is too young (1400-UPDATE restarts and returns) and a WRITE of the control record that answers DUPREC (1300-WRITE). ENQ BUSY, the control file's other conditions and the HANDLE ABEND label are not reached (the harness plans no fault for ENQ).
